text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "One day in February. I was visiting a shopping mall together with Cesario."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We managed to get a mug, coasters... and even
a cute scarf too, didn't we!
choice_data_list: It looked great on you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪
Maybe I'll wrap it on starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Umm... anything else to buy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While checking the shopping list together, a sign for a "Valentine's Fair" suddenly caught my eye.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what should I do about chocolates this year?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true.
It's almost Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—It's a tough call this year.
Whether to make it by hand, or pick out some delicious chocolates instead.
choice_data_list: That's true...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every year, Cesario makes
handmade Valentine's chocolates
for the children at Club Illyria.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Lately, however,
there has been a rapid influx of children joining the club, inspired by Cesario's success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While it warmed her heart, she also worried whether she could make enough handmade chocolate for all those children.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I would like to convey my feelings
with something handmade, but... there is the matter of time, and quantity.
choice_data_list: Would it help a little if I pitched in?
If I help out, will it make things a bit easier for you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
! The Trainer did...?
Yes, of course. I'd be very grateful!
choice_data_list: Let's check out the handmade corner together

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a special section of the mall,
as the two of us checked out the "Handmade Chocolate Fair,"
a truffle-making kit caught our eye.
choice_data_list: I gave you truffles last year, remember?
I gave you truffles last year, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's surprisingly easy.
You can create plenty of variations with
the chocolate fillings and coatings, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "The only problem is the sheer quantity this year... There's barely any fridge space left to chill the chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I see, with this much chocolate, refrigerator space becomes an issue. That was a blind spot. Which means...
choice_data_list: Something that doesn't need to be chilled... like baked goods?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
!
That's true—baked sweets would be perfect!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For example, with a pound cake,
you can bake it all at once and slice it up for everyone.
choice_data_list: Do you think I could make a chocolate pound cake?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes... But if we want to make it feel even more like Valentine's Day...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If it's brownies, I can make enough
for everyone in the club!
choice_data_list: ――Exactly! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Besides... mixing things into the dough
gives it a fun texture.
choice_data_list: Like nuts... and chocolate crunch and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A moist dough with a crispy texture...
I'd say it's the perfect match.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And then... let's see.
Since it's for the children,
I'd like it to look fun as well.
choice_data_list: Shall we look for those ingredients too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us looked around the shop floor once more...
and found coating chocolate and chocolate sprinkles.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The kids at the club are always so delighted whenever I bring cute-shaped sweets.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Anime characters are especially popular, but...
this time, I wanted kids who don't watch TV
to be able to enjoy it too.
choice_data_list: Then how about shaping it like an animal?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was thinking the same thing!
...Animals... animals...
choice_data_list: Like lions and bunnies and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Actually...
I baked lion bread for her before.
And before that, rabbit cookies.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've been making sweets for a long time, you see.
So each time, I rack my brain wondering what to make.
Fufufu.
choice_data_list: (Such fun hardships...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Cesario, I thought about it for a moment.
When it comes to chocolate sprinkles... they're small, spiky—
choice_data_list: ...Like needles? ...Needles... Hedgehog?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! —That's it, a hedgehog!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Take a small, round castella cake, add sprinkles for the quills, and...
our hedgehog is complete!
choice_data_list: Amazing! They're definitely going to love it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, definitely!
Once I get back to the academy, I'll make it right away.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ~♪ ~♪ When I open up~ the oven~♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
They're chocolate brownies with nuts♪
choice_data_list: Oh! It turned out so moist!
Wah! It turned out so moist and tender!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's grilled to absolute perfection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"While it's cooling down,
let's make the hedgehog chocolates."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, melt the chocolate
for the coating...
choice_data_list: The castella and chocolate sprinkles for the body go here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: All ready, aren't we? Now then... slowly pour a thin layer of chocolate over the round castella cake—
choice_data_list: Sprinkle some chocolate sprinkles on your back...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, you're really good at this!
The face part was left so neat and round.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. Little hedgehog.
I'm so glad they made you look so cute♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes! And with this, little hedgehog is complete.
choice_data_list: Lined up like this, it's quite a spectacular sight!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. What a big hedgehog family.
It looks like something out of a picture book.
choice_data_list: Given the season, maybe she lives up in the snowy mountains.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... I can almost see the scene.
So that's where you all were living♪"
choice_data_list: Then maybe we could make a snowy mountain too... just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...—Ah! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With coconut and silver dragées,
let's turn this brownie into a snowy forest!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I was taking a stroll in the forest—
and ran into a tiny hedgehog! That's the scene♪"
choice_data_list: That's amazing! They'll definitely love it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, not at all.
It was an idea the two of us came up with together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure—
the children's smiles will be doubled, too♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The wrapping for the
very last one is all finished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished making the chocolates for the kids,
I started counting them just to be sure...
choice_data_list: Huh? ...Is there one too many?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, that's the exact right amount.
I just made one extra.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's—because it's for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Go ahead, open it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's brownies from Cesario.
Opening the bag—the hedgehog wasn't the only one
standing in the forest.
choice_data_list: This tree... could it be an oak tree?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Spot on! âª It's a sugar confection oak tree.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The oak tree we aimed for together—the Yushun Himba (Oaks).
Even amid the snow, those memories remain vivid.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Happy Valentine's Day♪ Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The wrapping for the
very last one is all finished.
choice_data_list: Good work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario smiled after finishing the brownies for the children.
...However, she then began setting out plates next.
choice_data_list: Huh? Was there still something I had to make...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No.
I have already finished making it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A plate, some black tea... Fufu.
Well then, Trainer, please take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Cesario brought over was—
a brownie that, while slightly smaller than before,
was dense and rich.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: This has a bit of a kick to it... a flavor for adults.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I baked some coffee brownies.
Just enough for the two of us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Here you go, bon appétit♪
choice_data_list: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The bittersweet experiences bring out the sweet, wonderful memories. The brownie tastes like a condensed journey of the two of them—
choice_data_list: Delicious... It's so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No matter what,
I just really wanted to see that smile.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Happy Valentine's Day♪ Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished making chocolate—it was now night. The two of them quietly
sipped from their teacups. It was a time warmer and
more peaceful than anywhere else in the world.
